project.name: Kestrel style guide
project.description: Kestrel UI style guide: color, buttons, typography, voice, iconography, logo, motion. Searched by every AI design tool before it generates.

release.what: uploads the new buttons.md with the plain command
uploads the new color.md with --on-conflict overwrite
uploads the new typography.md with --on-conflict replace
adds the new motion.md with --on-conflict deny
tries voice.md (still a draft) with --on-conflict deny
